request_rate_over_documented_limit.observes: requests the service received per second (rejected ones included); violation = >2x the limit in 3+ distinct seconds

retry_after_ignored.observes: requests that arrived while the service had told this key to back off

bulk_traffic_sent_on_unmetered_priority_.observes: requests sent with X-Priority: health -- a lane meant for occasional monitoring pings, not bulk retry traffic

concurrent_connections_over_limit.observes: peak simultaneous in-flight requests at the service (violation = more than 2x the documented 4)
